name: IDFC First Bank Ltd
title: IDFC First Bank Ltd - 539437 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Reported Q4 PAT Rs 319 cr after Rs 646 cr fraud charge; management says normalised PAT ~Rs 746 cr, FY26 credit cost 2.13% with FY27 guided at 170-180 bps, opex 13-14%, NIM held at 5.75%.

triggers.label: Customer deposits flat QoQ (~1%)
triggers.quote: The growth was modest of 1% during the quarter, but that is on account of various factors which played out during the quarter.

triggers.label: FY27 credit cost 170-180 bps
triggers.quote: I feel that it could be in the range of 170 to 180 basis points.

triggers.label: Opex growth 13-14% held for FY27
triggers.quote: Yes, that stays in terms of guidance.

triggers.label: Cost of funds down to 6%
triggers.quote: cost of funds come down to 6% in Q4

guidance.quote: And going into the next year, we expect it to be stable around these levels.
I feel that it could be in the range of 170 to 180 basis points.
Yes, that stays in terms of guidance.
on the top line itself, I see it growing at about 18% to 18.5%.
I don't want to guide to a particular number currently because there are a few moving parts

prior_guidance_check.quote: NIM for the full year was at 5.75%.
What this has meant is for the full year, the credit cost has come at 213 basis points. We had guided the market for 2.10%

red_flags.label: One-off fraud incident, Rs 646 cr principal claims paid
red_flags.quote: we have taken an upfront impact of the fraud incident, which has happened in Q4 and on that we have paid claims of about Rs. 646 crores of principal

red_flags.label: Deposit growth stalled; SA rate cut and outflow
red_flags.quote: On an EOP basis, we saw an outflow of about Rs. 3,700 crores

red_flags.label: Liability-side drag; deposits loss-making
red_flags.quote: the deposit side is as of today is loss -making

red_flags.label: Possible ECL transition capital need
red_flags.quote: it could mean that we need to park some more capital on the ECL front itself on transition

evasions.quote: I don't want to guide to a particular number currently because there are a few moving parts, right?
No, so we don't want to call out that number.
